subject: Mystic Key
text: Awakening the Prince of Elfland rewards the Mystic Key, which can open any locked door.

evidence.quote:
The key will open any locked door, but you must awaken the
             | Prince of Elfland to get it.

subject: Oxyale
text: Oxyale is obtained from the fairy at the Fairy's Spring in Gaia after buying the Bottle from the Caravan, and provides fresh air in the submarine.

evidence.quote:
Fairy's Spring in Gaia, buy Bottle from Caravan...Available only from the Fairy's Spring in Gaia, and from the
             | hands of the Fairy herself, Oxyale is used to provide fresh
             | air in the submarine.

subject: Rod
text: Feeding the Ruby to the Titan allows passage to reach Sarda the Sage to obtain the Rod.

evidence.quote:
Get the Ruby, feed it to the Titan and he'll move and let you
             | pass to get to Sarda the Sage.

subject: Ruby
text: The Ruby is found in the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote:
Item:        | Ruby
Where Found: | Earth Cave

subject: Sailship
text: Defeating the pirates in Pravoka provides the pirate ship, which serves as the means of reaching the southern lands across the sea.

evidence.quote:
Where Found: | Defeat Pirates in Pravoka
Description: | The speedy pirate ship is your means of reaching the southern
             | lands across the sea.

subject: Slab
text: The Slab is found in the Sea Shrine and can be given to Dr. Unne so he will teach you the Lefeinish language.

evidence.quote:
Where Found: | Sea Shrine
Description: | The Slab contains important translations from Lefeinish. Give
             | it to Dr. Unne and he will teach you the language.

subject: Tail
text: The Tail is found in the Castle of Ordeals and must be handed over to Bahamut in the Cardia Islands to be promoted to a higher class.

evidence.quote:
Where Found: | Castle of Ordeals
Description: | Optional, but if you wish to be promoted to a higher class,
             | obtaining this item is neccessary. Hand it over to Bahamut in
             | the Cardia Islands.

subject: T.N.T.
text: T.N.T. is found in Coneria Castle after receiving the Mystic Key, and can be given to the dwarf in the Dwarf Cave to clear a path for a canal.

evidence.quote:
Where Found: | Coneria Castle after receiving Mystic Key from Dwarf.
Description: | This volatile explosive has been kept in the Treasure Vault
             | for 400 years. Give this to the Dwarf in the Dwarf Cave to
             | detonate rubble to clear a path for a canal.

subject: Masamune
text: The Masamune is picked up inside the bottom right room on floor B4 of the Temple of Fiends Revisited, where Tiamat is fought.

evidence.quote:
At the Temple of Fiends Revisted on floor B4, head to the bottom right
    part of the room(the room where you fight Tiamat in) and check the room
    inside to pick up the Masamune.

subject: Excalibur
text: To get the Excalibur, find the Adamant in the Floating Castle and take it to the dwarf in the Dwarf Cave.

evidence.quote:
Find the Adamant in the floating castle and take it to the Dwarf in
    the Dwarf cave.

subject: WarMech
text: The WarMech is found only in the long corridor leading up to Tiamat with a 1-64 chance of encounter, and recommended levels are at least 35.

evidence.quote:
The WarMech is a monster only found in the long corridor leading up to
    Tiamat...There is
    a 1-64 chance of encountering this guy...and if you meet him, I highly
    suggest you have levels of at least 35.

subject: Exit
text: The Exit spell can be used to escape if stuck in the Temple of Fiends 2000 years into the past.

evidence.quote:
5Q. Oh no! I'm stuck in the Temple of Fiends 2000 years into the past, how
    do I get back?
5A. Use the Exit spell.

subject: Level Cap
text: The maximum amount of levels that you can gain in the game is 50.

evidence.quote:
8Q. What is the maximum amount of levels that you can gain in this game?
8A. 50
